trainers.bio:
Opal O’Brien, owner & dog trainer with OPAWZ DOG TRAINING LLC. Opal was born in Kingston, Jamaica, West Indies.  She currently lives in Stone Mountain, GA
My love for all animals and dogs in particular began early in my life. Gigi was my first dog I had around the age of five or six. I started training with her, and as I got older, my love for her & other dogs deepened. She followed me everywhere, even to school, waited for me and then followed me home. She was my little protector and my best friend.
My knowledge and understanding of dog behavior and how they resolve conflict within the pack fascinated me especially how dogs respond to humans through proper/effective communication. Dog’s communication is through their body postures/language and the variety of their bark. I would be the one my friends and family called when they needed help with their dogs’ behavior. Through the years, my level of knowledge and hands on experience increased. I always felt this is my passion and my calling to help people with their dog (s) through education and training with both the owner and their dog.
Before I fully delved into working full-time training dogs and their owners, I worked in the mental health & substance abuse field as a clinical social worker. I incorporated my dog behavior knowledge & training skills, paired with Animal Assisted Therapy techniques with my clients, using my two dogs at the time, Mini a dachshund mix and Frisco, a chihuahua. Both, whom I trained to help me with the my work of helping people to become a better version of themselves, to help release the symptoms they had been struggling with for years. This technique helped build trust/openness to their innermost struggles in their life. This technique was the gateway to help decrease their anxiety/depression, paranoia & their symptoms of PTSD. This was so POWERFUL to see the growth & change in them! All with the assistance of my dogs.
My training techniques are customized to each puppy & dog no matter the breed, age or temperament/personality. I subscribe to balanced methods which is a combination of leadership and positive reinforcement, including behavior modification. I educate owners on communicating effectively with their dog(s), consistent with the training to get the result they want, which is a happy well behaved dog. I also equip them with training tools and techniques they need to reach their goal. I then teach the skill needed for them to become the leader of a balanced pack.
During the pandemic in 2020, I decided to shift gears and follow my true passion of working with dogs and helping their owners to better communicate with them.
I first became a Certified Dog Trainer through Animal Behavior College in 2003, but was training part-time, along with training my personal dogs. At that time I was working full-time in the mental health & substance abuse field.
So in 2021, I began working with a doggie daycare & boarding facility as the manager of the dog training program, which I developed &  put systems in place while also working with owners training their dogs. I also incorporate agility training in my training program. This helped the dogs to have fun while learning.
While working there, I attended Jo-Thor’s Dog Trainers’ Academy in Atlanta, GA where I received my certifications: Certified Professional Dog Educator & Trainer, Certified Advanced Dog Educator & Trainer.
In 2022, I obtained my Certified Master Dog Educator & Trainer certification and in 2023, I started my company OPAWz Dog Training LLC and I continue to help owners build a bond of mutual trust and respect between themselves and their dogs. My motto is, "No Problem.” to whatever dog behavior issues presents itself, whether is basic obedience, anxiety/reactivity or aggression. I work with all breeds, ages & sizes.

trainers.name: James Guillory
trainers.bio:
With over two decades of experience in competitive and pet dog training,  James Guillory is a respected leader in the world of canine behavior, law enforcement K9 preparation, and dog sport competition. 
Since 2003, James has trained and mentored multitudes of handler teams across a wide range of disciplines, specializing in working with challenging breeds and complex behavior modification cases.
A seasoned competitor in multiple dog sports, he has also served as Training Director for several prominent dog sport competition clubs. He has developed training programs that have led to success for countless teams and 
has been invited internationally to deliver seminars and workshops for K9 handlers and police departments and dog sport trainers, sharing deep technical knowledge and practical experience.
A former Vice President of the American Police and Protection Dog Association (APPDA), a role held for over five years, James Guillory has played a key role in shaping standards and supporting professional development within the protection dog community.
Whether training elite working dogs or helping families and their beloved pets coexist and thrive, James has the experience and ability to help your K9 companion, no matter how big or small the task.

I have extensive training in the areas of Service Dogs, serious behavior issues, socialization, various tools and I train in both a positive and balanced ideology. Most of my clients have been through many trainers before they come to me and are happy with the end result and continue with what they are taught throughout the life of the dog. My background includes working with military K9s, explosive detection K9s, and search and rescue K9s, ensuring dogs are highly skilled and reliable in high-stakes environments. I’ve also trained service dogs to assist individuals with disabilities, conservation K9s for wildlife and environmental protection, and protection K9s for security purposes.
Beyond specialized working dogs, I have extensive experience rehabilitating shelter dogs, giving them a second chance at life, and training pet dogs to become well-mannered companions. My diverse expertise allows me to tailor training programs to fit any dog’s needs, whether for work, service, or home life.
As a nationally certified Trainer, Instructor, and Explosive Detection K9 Handler, I combine proven techniques with real-world experience to deliver results. My mission is to help every dog reach its full potential while strengthening the bond between dog and owner through clear communication, trust, and consistency.
I believe that dogs are more than just animals—they are family. Every dog I work with is treated with love, respect, and compassion. My goal is not only to train dogs but to help build stronger, lifelong relationships between dogs and their owners.

trainers.bio:
Like many of my clients, I owned a dog that had behavioral issues but there wasn’t a dog trainer in my local area that could help me. I had adopted a young, female bully breed that matured into a dog with severe dog on dog aggression. Dog trainers in my home town weren’t equipped with the knowledge about behavior modification. So, I began doing my own research and working with my dog, Honey, to help her cope with a world that was filled with dogs. After a few failures but many successes, Honey was able to reach a level of advanced obedience and off leash reliability. We were often able to seamlessly move throughout crowds at dog friendly events without worry but I stayed vigilant and advocated for Honey’s personal space. This is where my passion for dog training was born.

The knowledge that I gained was further put to work when rescues, my local shelter and a dog rehabilitation farm began asking for help with their dogs. This helped me garner some unique experience that I still use in my daily dog training. Soon, I was under the apprenticeship of a local dog training company that eventually led to my employment as the lead dog trainer and behavior specialist of my local SPCA dog shelter. Through working at the shelter, I was forced to think of unique solutions for dog training in that high stress environment. With doing that, I was able to successfully place many dogs with a multitude of behavioral challenges into life-long homes. I also provided after adoption dog training support and helped to reduce the return or surrender of countless dogs.

I bring many years of dog training experience with me and a specialization in aggressive behavior and situations that need delicate or complex solutions. I have a judgment free, positive attitude and when it comes to aggressive behaviors, I’ve been there and done that! While I love watching the transformation of my challenging dog training clients, I also enjoy training all breeds for obedience and helping owners live happily with their pets!
